first_pass_desc: Document with character replaced by a slide titled 'Considerations for T-bill Issuance' with a round blue-and-gold Treasury seal at lower right.
Slide replaced by a figure titled 'Figure 1.6. Instrument composition of gross borrowing': flow chart left, line chart right, footnotes underneath.
Chart and pointer figure replaced by a small portrait beige page headed 'Key findings' with dense bullets and a source caption below.
The Key findings page zooms in and scrolls upward so the lower bullets fill the frame; the source caption rises and enlarges.
Replaced by the OECD-style line chart 'Instrument composition of gross borrowing' (right) and a smiling running stick figure at left.
Replaced by two green United States Treasury paper icons on empty white, one left and one right.
Replaced by a green US-map character (left, wide-eyed, stick legs) and a DEBT paper at right on white.
Speech bubble is gone and a green dollar money bag slides from beside the map character across to the foot of the DEBT paper.
Hard cut to an extreme close-up of the green map with pixel sunglasses over big eyes and white text 'I'd rather live on the edge'.
Replaced by a lone smiling stick figure (peach head, spiky hair, arms out) near centre on white.
Replaced by the US-map character (left) with bubble 'Uh yeah...' and a DEBT paper at far right.
Replaced by a single large DEBT paper at left on white; right side empty.
Hard cut (SD106) from DEBT and Treasury papers to the US-map character under a 'Let me borrow this...' bubble between two small DEBT papers; a money bag slides across.
Bubble 'Here's your payment!' appears and the money bag slides right from the map character to the right DEBT paper.
Hard cut (SD107) to a DEBT paper ringed by three curved red arrows that rotate; at the end a smiling stick figure replaces it.
Replaced by a light-blue definition card 'Rollover Risk' (sharks and circular dollar arrows) at centre and a stick figure with pointer at lower right.
Card replaced by '30 yrs' handwritten above a yellow ornate BOND certificate at left on white; big two-frame cut.
Replaced by the green US-map character (left, wide eyes) and a DEBT paper at right on white.
Hard cut: map character and DEBT paper replaced by a single centred smiling stick figure with arms out on white. Machine class said partial; whole composition changes.
Hard cut from stick figure to a bar chart (four purple bars, title 'Average Interest Rate by Security Type'); bars grow from zero up to final heights and value labels appear.
Tiny value label above the second (Bills) bar settles from a blurred/counter-like reading to final '3.758%' at top centre; nothing else changes.
Hard cut from bar chart with red line to a full-frame report figure page ('Figure 1.13', four small panels) filling the canvas.
The report figure page scales up about 1.7x anchored top-left, cropping at right and bottom, while a smiling stick figure with a pointer enters at bottom-left.
Red rounded-rectangle highlight is drawn around the 'US 1-YR' row of the table (left-centre), growing to a closed box.
Hard cut from table with red boxes to a white text slide 'Composition of U.S. debt' (four bullets, source line) with three DEBT papers at bottom right.
DEBT paper with dollar bill at upper-left drops straight down the left side and leaves the frame at bottom; host figure stays and changes arm pose.
A DEBT paper (no bill) rises from the bottom edge to settle at the right of the host figure.
Red arrow travels from the lower-left (Jul 2021) up and rightward along the chart lines to the top-right end of the Bills line, tracking the curve.
Embedded clip plays: puppet raises a hand, a second figure joins, then a pasted 'Panik' head image pops in at right; at the end a hard cut returns to the stick figure.
Hard cut from chart screenshot to a white text excerpt ('The federal government already spends more on interest than on budget areas such as:') with bullet list and handwritten source line.
A green map-shaped character with a smile enters from the right edge, partly cropped, overlapping right of the text.
Hard cut from text with map character to a 'Net interest costs are projected to rise sharply' area chart screenshot; blue area grows from flat to a rising shape.

Hard cut from map close-up to a collage of small country-shaped characters with a live-action reaction clip at top centre (caption 'WE ARE SCREWED!' appears); near the end it cuts to the laptop scene.
Host figure swaps to a slumped pose: head drops onto the laptop with X-eyes and open mouth; PDF pane also scrolls.
PDF pane scrolls briefly, then hard cut at about frame 18499 from the desk/laptop scene to a centred smiling detective-hat stick figure holding a magnifier.
Bearded DEBT paper jiggles/shifts slightly for about two seconds, then hard cut near frame 18811-18816 back to the OECD text page.
Not a partial replace: 70 frames of looping animated meme (fire flicker) inside a static frame, then on the last frame (20182) a hard cut to the Figure 2.23 hyperscaler bond-issuance page.
Two hard cuts, not regional animation: 21569 certificates to a brown-haired figure beside a pension line chart with red arrow; ~21628 to green countries cartoon. Arrow slides left to right between.
